book.name: PANKITE
book.title: Yeisu Keliso wana Pankite Diyon elana

content: Diyon Yabowaine I Kite wana Abamisiyowa

Sauga gamagal o wana baaba i pwamowasi, inoke matau ya lihin ge ya kite labulabum ana nog i mwapwela. Yaka anan toto ya hahago houwan i ola bwagigi anana i ba, “U heem hiwe natiya e, ge na pankitewa hauna gun mulaa abwe ni gan.”
Sauga o Yayaluwa wana gasisi i aheyau, inoke abamisiyo wawasana etega ya kite labulabumwa, gamagal etega i misiyowa.

Gamagal o ana awa i namanamal i ola pat diyaspa ge pat keketina alana kaneliyan namanamalina. Yaka liliyal etega ya kite i namanamal i ola pat alaalawana alana emelold, gamagal o wana abamisiyo i howa painan.

Abamisiyo wawasana ali gewi tuwenti po al abamisiyo toto o hi mipainan, ge tonowakau bwabwatal ali gewi tuwenti po kaliko yayanana hi galoi ge ali hanahana gold hi teliya kokowaliyaa hi misiyowa to abamina bolo o elal.
Pipinamal ge gulumwawa butuna i nemnem to abamisiyo bwabwatana elana. Abamisiyo o awonaa odam ali gewi seben hi tautau, odam o Yehoba Yayaluwana, iya i ola yayaluwa seben.

Ge bugul etega al iyoho abamisiyo awonaa ana awa i ola hoga matana i kanakana hot i ola gelasi matana. I ola al bwasumu esopali ya kitel, mataliya tuwaliya bwalibwaligena i pakalaopop, maniniliyaa ge eliyaa, ge abamisiyo toto gamagal i misiyowa hi mipainan.
Bwasumu etegana ana awa i ola laiyoni, eluwana ana awa i ola bulumakau, etonina maninina ana awa i ola gamagal, ge esopalena ana awa i ola magisubu i youyou.
He bwasumu esopali maisena ge maisena opeliya ali gewi sikis, ge mataliya tuwaliya bwalibwaligena i pakalaopop, i ola al opeliya gabulanaa. Lan ge bulin hi wonawona nige hi veveyaho, hi ba,

content.text: “Yehoba Yabowaine Togasisi Hot, iya i bwabwalena,
sauga ya ge sauga i nenem elal.”

content: Sauga ebo bwasumu bolo o awa wasawasa, awatauwan ge ba tobal nihi baunan toto yawalina mihomihotina i misiyo abamisiyo wawasana elana,

inoke tonowakau bwabwatal ali toto tuwenti po nihi loepwakokuwa manininaa ge nihi tapwalolo elana. Ali hanahana nihi teliya abamisiyo wawasana awonaa toto gamagal i misiyowa, ge nihi wonawona nihi ola,

content.text: i bosowaina naha awa wasawasa-agiwa, naha
awatauwagiwa ge wam gasisi naha tobalan,
inoke wam nuwatu elana hi masal.”
